alcance: Local rehearsal with synthetic data. Checks that the logical dump and roles restore without errors. It does not compare contents, row counts, schema or permission digests, test a physical backup or start VEC. It does not declare a backup valid or enable an operational restore.
restauracion_logica_completada: The synthetic logical restore completed and its temporary resources were removed.
restauracion_logica_fallida: The logical rehearsal did not complete successfully. Review the reported stage and check; data and internal errors are not shown.
uso: Specify -configuracion file.json -solicitud file.json -catalogo file.json. Use synthetic files only. The rehearsal creates and removes its own isolated PostgreSQL instance.
error_argumentos: Specify the configuration, request and message catalogue files.
error_catalogo: The rehearsal message catalogue could not be read.
error_entrada: Check the files and configuration limits for the synthetic sample.
error_salida: The rehearsal result could not be written.
